youtube.description:
5 mistakes that wreck a Kiro spec (and how to avoid them)

Five mistakes that wreck a Kiro spec.

1. Vague prompts - Vague in, vague requirements out.
2. Skipping the review - Read requirements before design starts.
3. One giant spec - Split big ideas into smaller specs.
4. Never reading design - design.md is where Kiro shows its plan.
5. Letting specs go stale - When code changes, update the spec too.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/best-practices/
